headline: Venture capitalist Vinod Khosla says AI could do 65 percent of all jobs within two decades.
score_reason: Pool 6 lowered by 1: headline stronger than the description and unverified.
importance_line: A long-range forecast of job change matters to workers, but it is one investor's prediction from a summit talk, with no supporting evidence given.
summary: Yahoo reports that venture capitalist Vinod Khosla told the Masters of Scale Summit that within 20 years AI could do 65 percent of all jobs, which he says need not be bad, because the wealth it creates could let people stop doing jobs they dislike.
notes: Headline only: the Yahoo video page gave a 273-character description and no other outlet was found in two searches. The summary is one cautious sentence. Khosla's organisation is not stated in the readable text; the position given is venture capitalist only.
